unit.why: A brief memorate, reported from the rebbetzin, of a conversation in which her father the holy Maggid foretells that her son will surpass him.

stories.start_quote: כז שמעתי כ״פ מאמר הרבנית הצדקת
stories.summary_en: The rebbetzin related that her father the holy Maggid told her that her son would be greater and better than he; she answered that it would suffice if he were as good as him, and he insisted that her son would be greater.

tags.why: The Maggid speaks with his daughter about his grandson.

quotes: מאמר הרבנית הצדקת ז"ל, כי אביה
tags.why: The rebbetzin takes part in the dialogue and transmits the tale, but the story is brief.

quotes: תדע שבנך יחיה גדול וטוב ממני
tags.why: The Maggid foretells the grandson's greatness, implicitly fulfilled.
The whole anecdote is a prediction about a future tzaddik.

quotes: ולואי שיהיה טוב כמו אתה, ואיני חפץ יותר
tags.why: The daughter modestly asks for no more than her father's level.

missing_concepts: grandson surpassing grandfather / generational ascent of tzaddikim
